Canonical corresponding AUCs: neither 0.6659956925, linear 0.6656991013, quadratic 0.6657623039, both 0.6660661993. These are adaptive single-seed controlled observations, not repeated support. Both partial replacements failed to preserve incumbent quality; the combined channel benefit may reflect smooth order, positional coding, optimization or interacting readouts.
study.hypothesis: On supplied history layout, the two smooth coarse moments summarize low-order variation across source block indices more usefully than a fixed scrambled-rank polynomial pair of matched individual event-weighted norms and inherited support. Canonical-layout scrambled results contextualize any layout interaction. This is a narrow follow-up to incomplete local replacements, not a new architecture, chronology claim, order-invariance test or verified novelty.
